basic.name: Hungering Arrow
basic.description: Fire an arrow that deals 140~~0.04~~ damage to the first target hit, then seeks up to 2 additional enemies, prioritizing Heroes, dealing 80~~0.04~~ damage. Can hit an enemy multiple times.

basic.name: Multishot
basic.description: Deal 159~~0.04~~ damage to enemies within the target area.

basic.name: Vault
basic.description: Dash to the target area. Valla's next Basic Attack within 2 seconds deals 6% increased damage per stack of Hatred.

heroic.name: Strafe
heroic.description: Rapidly attack enemies within 10 range for 70~~0.04~~ damage per hit, prioritizing Heroes over Minions. Valla is able to move and use Vault while strafing. Lasts for 4 seconds.

heroic.name: Rain of Vengeance
heroic.description:
Launch a wave of Shadow Beasts that deals 250~~0.04~~ damage and Stuns enemies in the target area for 0.5 seconds.

Stores up to 2 charges.

trait.name: Hatred
trait.description: Basic Attacks grant a stack of Hatred, up to 10. Each Hatred stack increases Basic Attack damage by 8% and Movement Speed by 1%. Lasts 5 seconds.

activable.name: Gloom
activable.description:
Activate to consume all Hatred, granting 3 Spell Armor per Hatred consumed for 5 seconds.

Passive: Gain 15 Spell Armor, and each stack of Hatred heals for 1.2~~0.04~~ Health per second.

level1.name: Puncturing Arrow
level1.description:
Increase the number of Hungering Arrow bounces by 1.

Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Hungering Arrow refunds 40 Mana and permanently increases the damage of its initial impact by 6.

level1.name: Fire At Will
level1.description:
Quest: Hitting a Hero with Multishot grants 2 Hatred and permanently increases its damage by 2.

Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes with Multishot, increase its damage by 40.

level1.name: Creed of the Hunter
level1.description:
Quest: Every 50 Basic Attacks against Heroes increases Hatred's damage bonus per stack by 1%, up to 6%.

Gambit: Gain 25% bonus Attack Speed. Every death reduces this bonus by 5%.

level4.name: Arsenal
level4.description: Increase the range of Multishot by 20%. Multishot also fires 3 grenades that deal 100~~0.04~~ damage and refund 25 Mana after hitting enemy Heroes.

level4.name: Death Dealer
level4.description:
Increase Vaults Basic Attack damage bonus from 6% to 15% per stack of Hatred. If this attack kills its victim within 1.5 seconds, the Mana cost and cooldown of Vault are refunded.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Vault by 5 seconds.

level4.name: Repeating Arrow
level4.description: Vault no longer has a Mana cost. Casting Vault resets the cooldown of Hungering Arrow.

level7.name: Monster Hunter
level7.description: Hungering Arrow deals 150% additional damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level7.name: Frost Shot
level7.description: Multishot Slows enemies by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Hungering Arrows deals 25% more damage to Slowed enemies.

level7.name: Hot Pursuit
level7.description: Increase the Movement Speed bonus of each stack of Hatred from 1% to 2%.

level10.name: Strafe
level10.description: Rapidly attack enemies within 10 range for 70~~0.04~~ damage per hit, prioritizing Heroes over Minions. Valla is able to move and use Vault while strafing. Lasts for 4 seconds.

level10.name: Rain of Vengeance
level10.description:
Launch a wave of Shadow Beasts that deals 250~~0.04~~ damage and Stuns enemies in the target area for 0.5 seconds.

Stores up to 2 charges.

level13.name: Siphoning Arrows
level13.description: Hitting a Hero with Hungering Arrow heals Valla for 4% of her maximum Health, and Multishot heals for 2%.

level13.name: Tempered by Discipline
level13.description: Basic Attacks heal for 10% of the damage dealt, increased by 2% per Hatred stack.

level13.name: Gloom
level13.description:
Activate to consume all Hatred, granting 3 Spell Armor per Hatred consumed for 5 seconds.

Passive: Gain 15 Spell Armor, and each stack of Hatred heals for 1.2~~0.04~~ Health per second.

level16.name: Punishment
level16.description:
While at max Hatred, Multishot's cooldown recharges 50% faster.

Passive: Reduce Multishot's Mana cost from 75 to 55.

level16.name: Seething Hatred
level16.description: While at max Hatred, increase all damage dealt by 10%.

level16.name: Manticore
level16.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 4% of their maximum Health as damage.

level20.name: Death Siphon
level20.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Strafe increases its duration by 0.125 seconds. Strafe also fires penetrating bolts in a line for 34~~0.04~~ damage every 0.25 seconds.

level20.name: Storm of Vengeance
level20.description:
Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Rain of Vengeance by 5 seconds.

Passive: Each stack of Hatred increases your Attack Speed by 2%. While at max Hatred, gain an additional 30% Attack Speed.

level20.name: Acrobat
level20.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Vault. Drop 3 Caltrops while Vaulting that deal 60~~0.04~~ damage and Slow enemies by 40% for 1 second.

level20.name: Farflight Quiver
level20.description: Gain 20% Basic Attack range. While at max Hatred, gain an additional 30% Basic Attack range.
